svg.title: flowchart diagram
svg.desc: A flowchart diagram with 16 nodes and 25 edges. Flowing top to bottom. Key nodes: Ingress, Normalize, Deduplicate. Key relationships: Ingress points to Normalize; Ingress points to Deduplicate; Ingress points to Prioritize. Layout spans 727 by 655 units with 16 rendered node boxes and 25 routed edge paths.
